verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents agent-readable docs (llms.txt confirmed by probe, official MCP server) and prompt-to-video submission endpoints, so an agent can submit a prompt and receive webhooks on batch jobs. Cost is covered only indirectly through a credit-balance endpoint, not a per-job cost, and no evidence shows an endpoint for polling job status or fetching the rendered asset. The OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404. Missing for 10: documented job-status polling, documented asset retrieval/download endpoint, per-job cost reporting, a reachable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run the full video loop from docs alone: submit the prompt, watch the job, fetch the asset, and report the cost

citations.quote: Every endpoint ships with an MCP server, llms.txt, and typed schemas — so Claude, Cursor, and your own agents can generate video without glue code.
Create videos from a text prompt with full control over avatar, voice, style, and file inputs.
Batch APIs — up to 100 requests per call, webhooks included
Retrieve the authenticated user's profile, credit balance, and plan tier
